heading: Definitions
lead: Terms used in this part (other than Administrator) shall have the same meaning as such terms have under section 40102(a) of title 49.

notes.text: Codification In text, “section 40102(a) of title 49” substituted for “section 101 of the Federal Aviation Act of 1958” on authority of Pub. L. 103–272, § 6(b), July 5, 1994, 108 Stat. 1378, the first section of which enacted subtitles II, III, and V to X of Title 49, Transportation. Section was formerly classified to section 1857f–12 of this title.
